story.title: Story 6: Blocked And Degraded Deterministic Maintenance State

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on convergence for F6-01, F6-02, and F6-03 across the touched production paths and new regression coverage, then reran focused tests plus the story and epic gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved in src/thread-view/services/thread-view-materializer.ts:451-460 and 509-513, which now emit THREAD_VIEW_STATE_CONFLICT and mark the full-fidelity band blocked when selected messageIds cannot be resolved. tests/thread-view/thread-view-materializer.test.ts:102-141 confirms the missing-message scenario yields explicit invalid state and no partial full-fidelity emission.

Resolved in src/context-workbench/services/workbench-query-service.ts:143-177 and 195-217, where chunk inspection now flags unresolved sourceTurnIds as CHUNK_STATE_INVALID before openChunkDetail returns the chunk record. tests/context-workbench/workbench-query-service.test.ts:765-796 verifies the invalid state is surfaced through normal chunk inspection.

Resolved in src/commands/smart-compact.ts:137-153, which now persists degraded generated-output metadata with blocker issues for threshold failures, and src/context-workbench/services/workbench-query-service.ts:307-323 plus 513-524, which merge generated-output issues into inspectable blockers and degraded usableStatus. tests/commands/smart-compact.test.ts:565-599 and tests/context-workbench/workbench-query-service.test.ts:799-823 confirm LOWER_THRESHOLD_UNREACHED remains inspectable after degraded compact results.

additionalObservations: The three carried blockers are closed by production-path changes plus direct regression tests; no new touched-surface regressions were found.
Generated-output metadata now carries inspectable issue details, and workbench inspection consumes that real persisted metadata rather than a shimmed status path.
No material fake adapter, shim, or placeholder workaround was introduced outside the story’s intended deterministic placeholder behavior.
